boundary: This figure is a protocol/asset map, not a performance result.
Scope is Mojahid and Res-SAM only; 4TU and blind external assets are not included in this matrix.
Do not frame as a universal leakage effect; only 1/5 model families reaches material support.
This is stress-test and feasibility-boundary evidence, not final causal proof, main confirmation or blind external validation.
This is a gate/failure-mode result; it supports study design decisions, not model superiority.
The locked evaluation is template dry-run only; no manuscript claim can call it real blind external validation.
Counts are local executable rows, not global dataset sizes.
Summary excludes 4TU and true blind external validation.
May be internal planning material unless the manuscript is framed as a benchmark/resource paper.
